Observability._comment_ServiceName: traceId/spanId/service/level are the mandatory fields on every log entry (observability-standards.md); ServiceName is the 'service' field. STANDARD sampling tier (design-decisions.md) - no Otlp override needed beyond the default sampler.

Otlp._comment_Endpoint: OpenTelemetry Collector OTLP/gRPC endpoint. Services never ship traces/logs to Tempo/Loki directly (observability-standards.md).

GlobalConfig._comment_Path: Absolute path to a JSON file, outside the repo and never committed, holding this environment's actual ConnectionStrings/RabbitMq credentials (kart-conventions.md Configuration Management). Program.cs layers it on top of this file at startup and fails fast if the path is unset or missing. Local dev sets the concrete path in appsettings.Local.json; a deployed environment supplies it via the GlobalConfig__Path env var pointing at a mounted secret file.

ConnectionStrings._comment_NotificationDb: Secret - supplied via the GlobalConfig file, never committed.

RabbitMq._comment: ManifestPath points at message-bus-manifest.json (copied here at build time from contracts/) - the single source of truth for this service's entire RabbitMQ topology (exchanges, queues, bindings, dead-letter/retry wiring). HostName is the only non-secret messaging setting not described by the manifest.
RabbitMq._comment_UserNamePassword: Secret - supplied via the GlobalConfig file, never committed. RabbitMQ's default 'guest' user only works over a literal loopback connection, so any real broker needs a dedicated non-guest user here.
